headline: Sakuretsu Armor
title: Sakuretsu Armor Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Sakuretsu Armor. What is it? It is a Normal Trap Card. What does it do? When your opponent's monster declares an attack, destroy that attacking monster. How do you use it? It is a simple one for one answer to any attacker. Keep it for their biggest attacker. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
